messages:
Priya Nair: FYI customer 'beta-llc' reported login failures and a bunch of 'mapping failed' errors in SAML intake. Also seeing SCIM create -> 201 then immediate duplicate user events.

Liam O'Sullivan: can you paste the SAML error from auth-ingest?

Priya Nair: log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z WARN saml-ingest: attribute mapping failed relayState=/sso/beta error=missing_nameid_format expected="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress"
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z ERROR scim-provisioner: create user failed status=409 externalId='beta-42 ' email='Dev+Beta@Beta-LLC.com'
```

Ethan Zhao: note trailing space in externalId and weird email case + plus addressing. our normalizer should lowercase emails and strip whitespace, but the SCIM payload shows raw values. Did we recently change any normalization rules?

Samira Gupta: not that I recall. There was an RBAC rename last week: role `beta_admin` -> `beta:admin` to standardize colon sep. That touched the provisioning templates for some customers. Could've introduced a template regression.

deploy-bot: deploy services/auth-ingest@2026-03-21T02:10 UTC succeeded (hash: ddd111). Trigger: infra/iam-cleanup

Liam O'Sullivan: good catch. Could be the template used for NameID format or attribute mapping used `{{role}}` and blew up when we changed delimiter. But SCIM dups + SAML mapping fail sound like two separate failures from same deploy.

Priya Nair: I grabbed a raw SAML assertion (redacted):
```
<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent">abc123</NameID>
<Attribute Name="email">Dev+Beta@Beta-LLC.com</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="externalId">beta-42 </Attribute>
<Attribute Name="roles">beta:admin</Attribute>
```

Ethan Zhao: our mapper expects NameID as emailAddress format for this integration. If IdP started sending persistent, mapper refuses. Did the customer change IdP settings? Their support note says they upgraded their IdP plugin on 2026-03-20.

Samira Gupta: check KMS logs too  we saw some decryption failures in the same timeframe for SAML signatures. Could be key rotation noise.

Liam O'Sullivan: CloudTrail snippet:
```
2026-03-20T05:01:13Z ReEncrypt KeyId: alias/rdw-saml-signing, SrcKeyId: xxxxx, DestKeyId: yyyyy, EncryptionContext: {tenant: "beta-llc"}
2026-03-21T02:09:58Z Decrypt KeyId: alias/rdw-saml-signing, EncryptionContext: {tenant: "beta_llc"}
```

Priya Nair: aha - dash vs underscore in tenant context. mapper and scim-provisioner pass tenant differently depending on codepath. That would cause signature verification to fail post-rotation.

Ethan Zhao: so combined root cause: 1) IdP changed NameID format -> attribute mapper rejects 2) deploy/iam-cleanup changed role naming -> template mismatch could affect mapping rules 3) KMS rekey changed alias and now EncryptionContext canonicalization mismatch causes signature verification to intermittently fail 

Samira Gupta: impact: ~45 failed logins, 23 SCIM duplicate creations (most resolved), and audit gaps for role assignment events during 2:00-03:30 UTC window. We should declare an incident and runback.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-031 opened by Samira Gupta: SAML mapping and SCIM duplicates for tenant beta-llc (severity: medium). Pager duty: on-call alerted.

Liam O'Sullivan: immediate mitigations I propose: revert role template change for beta-llc via legacy mapping, relax NameID strictness to accept persistent as fallback (log and metric), and roll back to previous KMS alias mapping or add EncryptionContext alias-resolver that tolerates underscore/dash.

Priya Nair: I can push a quick rule to normalize tenant id in KMS calls (strip punctuation and map underscores to dashes) as hotfix. Also will add trimming for externalId and lowercasing for email in scim-consumer.

Ethan Zhao: I'll open PR to make NameID mapping accept emailAddress OR persistent if email attribute present. Add a counter metric for "saml_nameid_fallback".

Samira Gupta: I'll coordinate customer comms. Also need an audit entry in our post-incident review about the RBAC rename process  we should gate template changes behind a compatibility test.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy scim-consumer@2026-03-22T10:15 UTC succeeded (hash: cf12ab)

Priya Nair: rolled normalization hotfix, requeued 30 SCIM ops - 27 succeeded, 3 still colliding due to legitimately different externalIds that normalize to same value. I'm running a safe-merge script that requires manual approval.

Ethan Zhao: NameID fallback merged in staging, added unit tests. Will push to prod after green run.

Liam O'Sullivan: created alert rule: config-drift: role-template != canonical-template for tenants. also added a KMS-context-mismatch metric based on Decrypt error parsing.

security-bot: filed vuln ticket VULN-2026-115 (low/med) for potential KMS context canonicalization bug allowing signature verification gaps. Assigned to Priya Nair.

Samira Gupta: follow-ups: 1) Priya create runbook section for KMS alias rotations and canonicalization rules 2) Liam add compatibility test in CI for role renames that exercises mapping templates 3) Ethan ensure SAML mapper has robust fallbacks and telemetry 4) Ops: run a daily scan for tenants with both underscore and dash variants in metadata

Priya Nair: on it. I'll also attach the reconcile list to the incident so we can audit merges.

Liam O'Sullivan: great work team. Customer confirmed logins restored after hotfix and we scheduled a low-risk template migration window to reapply the RBAC rename with tests.

Samira Gupta: closing incident in 24h after postmortem notes. Thanks all. :heart:
